/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement sentence-level context pruning, a real technique for trimming a retrieved chunk down to only its query-relevant sentences before it consumes generation context budget.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement FLARE-style active retrieval triggering, deciding mid-generation whether a just-generated sentence is confident enough to keep, or uncertain enough to warrant pausing for fresh retrieval.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Align Answer Sentences to Best Supporting Chunk

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Detect Ambiguous Query Needing Clarification
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement query-ambiguity detection, catching a real case where an agentic RAG system should ask a clarifying question rather than silently guessing which real-world entity the user meant.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Speculative RAG: Select the Best-Supported Draft Answer
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Speculative RAG's real verification step: generate multiple candidate draft answers from different chunk subsets, then pick whichever draft is most supported by the actually-retrieved facts.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Allocate Retrieval Budget Across a Multi-Step Plan
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement retrieval-budget allocation across a multi-step agentic RAG plan, distributing a limited total number of retrieval calls proportionally to each step's real complexity.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Self-Ask: Parse Follow-Up Question Pattern
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Self-Ask prompting's step-line parser, extracting structured meaning from the real, distinctive output format of the Self-Ask technique for decomposed multi-hop reasoning.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Corrective RAG: Grade Retrieved Document Relevance
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Corrective RAG's real three-way relevance grading, deciding whether to proceed with retrieved documents, fall back to a web search, or blend both.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Extractive Document Compression by Top Sentences
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement extractive document compression, keeping only the highest-scored sentences of a retrieved chunk (in original reading order) before passing it to the generator -- a real, cheap alternative to abstractive (LLM-rewritten) compression.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Conversational Query Rewriting via Coreference
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement conversational query rewriting, resolving a pronoun in a follow-up question back to the real entity from the previous conversation turn -- essential for multi-turn RAG chat to retrieve correctly.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Calibrate Answer Confidence From Retrieval Score Distribution
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement retrieval-margin-based confidence calibration, a real signal distinguishing 'one document is a clear, confident match' from 'several documents are similarly, ambiguously relevant.'

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: RAG Answer Abstention Decision
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement RAG abstention, a real, honest 'I don't know' policy for when retrieval genuinely found nothing good enough to answer from, rather than forcing a generation from weak/irrelevant context.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Select Best Multi-Vector Representation for a Document
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement multi-vector representation selection, choosing WHICH of a document's several stored embeddings (full text, summary, hypothetical questions it answers) best matches a given query.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Compute Pipeline Ablation Score Delta
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement ablation-score-delta computation, the real, standard way to measure how much a specific RAG pipeline component (reranking, query rewriting, compression) actually contributes to overall quality.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Self-RAG: Parse ISREL/ISSUP/ISUSE Critique Tokens

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Compute Real Retrieval Diversity via MMR-Style Redundancy Penalty
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement a real redundancy-penalty computation, the diversity half of any MMR-style diverse-retrieval selection, measuring how similar a candidate chunk is to what's already been chosen.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Determine Multi-Hop Reasoning Chain Completion

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Agentic Retrieval Tool Selection

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Iterative Retrieval Stopping via Information Gain
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement iterative-retrieval stopping logic, a real decision an agentic RAG loop makes each round: keep retrieving more context, or is additional retrieval no longer worth it.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Decompose a Compound Question Into Subquestions
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement real query decomposition, splitting a compound multi-part question into independently-retrievable subquestions -- a real, standard technique for questions naive single-shot retrieval handles poorly.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Adaptive Retrieval K Based on Query Complexity
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement adaptive top-k selection, retrieving more chunks for genuinely complex queries and fewer for simple ones instead of a fixed k for every query.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Self-Query: Extract Structured Metadata Filter From Natural Language
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement self-querying metadata extraction, a real technique letting a RAG system parse structured filters (year, category, author) directly out of a natural-language query rather than requiring separate filter UI.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Practice: Answer Verification Loop Decision
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement a real answer-verification decision, an agentic RAG loop's self-check step deciding whether to accept a generated answer, regenerate it, or retrieve fresh context.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Practice: Sliding-Window Text Chunking for RAG

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: NDCG@K Ranking Quality

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Mean Average Precision at K (MAP@K)
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement Average Precision@K for one user, the per-query building block of the MAP@K metric used to evaluate recommendation ranking quality.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Recommendation Catalog Coverage
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement catalog coverage, a real diversity/business metric measuring what fraction of the entire catalog a recommender ever surfaces.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Intra-List Diversity of a Recommendation List
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement intra-list diversity, the standard metric for how varied a single recommendation list is, not just how accurate.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Popularity-Based Baseline Recommender
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the popularity baseline every real recommender system is measured against, and the standard cold-start fallback.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Content-Based Filtering Score
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the core content-based filtering score: cosine similarity between a user's preference profile and a candidate item's feature vector.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Hybrid Recommendation Score Blending
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement weighted score blending, the simplest real way to combine a collaborative-filtering model with a content-based model into one hybrid recommender.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Bayesian Personalized Ranking (BPR) Pairwise Loss
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the Bayesian Personalized Ranking loss, a real pairwise objective used to train implicit-feedback recommenders directly for ranking rather than rating prediction.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Implicit Feedback Confidence Weighting
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the real confidence-weighting formula from Hu, Koren & Volinsky's implicit-feedback ALS paper, used whenever recommendations are trained on clicks/views/plays instead of explicit star ratings.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: K-Means Centroid Update Step
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the update (M) step of Lloyd's k-means algorithm.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: K-Medoids Total Clustering Cost
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the k-medoids objective function -- like k-means but using real data points as cluster centers, more robust to outliers.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Mean Shift Update Step
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement one iteration of the mean shift algorithm, a real mode-seeking clustering method that discovers the number of clusters automatically.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Cluster Purity Score
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement cluster purity, an external validation metric that scores clustering quality against known ground-truth labels.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Adjusted Rand Index Between Two Clusterings
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the Adjusted Rand Index, the standard chance-corrected metric for comparing two clusterings (or a clustering against ground truth).

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Dunn Index Cluster Validity
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the Dunn Index, an internal cluster-validity metric that needs no ground truth -- higher is better, rewarding compact well-separated clusters.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Elbow Method: Detect the Knee in a WCSS Curve
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement a real, deterministic knee-detection rule for the elbow method, turning a subjective visual heuristic into a reproducible function.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Cold-Start Recommendation Fallback Weighting
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement a real cold-start blending weight: how much to trust personalized (CF) recommendations versus a popularity fallback, based on how much history a user actually has.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Practice: Session-Based Next-Item Markov Score

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-1.title: Practice: Exact-Match Task Accuracy
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-1.description: Implement exact-match accuracy, the simplest real agent-evaluation metric -- what fraction of outputs are byte-for-byte identical to the expected answer.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-10.title: Practice: Regression Detection Between Two Eval Runs
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-10.description: Implement eval regression detection, finding SPECIFIC test cases that flipped from passing to failing between two versions -- more actionable than comparing aggregate scores alone.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-11.title: Practice: Compute Real Cost Per Eval Run
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-11.description: Implement real eval-run cost computation, since input and output tokens are typically priced differently and a full eval suite run against a real API genuinely costs money.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-12.title: Practice: Statistical Significance of an Eval Score Delta
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-12.description: Implement statistical-significance testing for an eval score comparison, the real gate before claiming 'model B genuinely beats model A' rather than a difference explainable by eval-set sample noise.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-13.title: Practice: Compute Real Token Usage Cost Attribution by User
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-13.description: Implement per-user cost attribution, a real observability requirement for any multi-tenant agent deployment needing to bill or budget-track individual users.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-14.title: Practice: Detect Silent Eval Harness Failures
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-14.description: Implement silent-failure detection in an eval harness, catching test cases that neither clearly passed nor clearly failed -- a real, common eval-infrastructure bug that silently inflates or deflates reported scores.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-15.title: Practice: Weighted Composite Eval Score
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-15.description: Implement weighted composite scoring, combining several individually-meaningful eval metrics (accuracy, latency, cost) into one real overall number for a leaderboard or gating decision.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-16.title: Practice: Sliding Window Error Rate Monitoring
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-16.description: Implement sliding-window error-rate monitoring, giving a real-time observability dashboard a responsive, recency-weighted error signal instead of an all-time cumulative average that reacts too slowly to a fresh incident.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-17.title: Practice: Extract Structured Tool-Call Events From a Trace
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-17.description: Implement tool-call event extraction from a raw agent execution trace, the real filtering step behind a 'show me every tool this agent called' observability view.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-18.title: Practice: Compute Eval Confidence Interval (Wilson Score)
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-18.description: Implement the Wilson score confidence interval, a real, more statistically sound alternative to a naive normal-approximation interval for reporting uncertainty on a small-sample eval pass rate.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-19.title: Practice: Alert Deduplication by Fingerprint
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-19.description: Implement alert deduplication, a real, necessary filter preventing an observability system from paging an on-call engineer once per occurrence of what's really the same ongoing incident.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-2.title: Practice: LLM-as-Judge Score Normalization
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-2.description: Implement judge-score normalization, converting an LLM-as-judge's raw rating (on whatever scale the judge prompt used) into a standard [0,1] range for aggregation across differently-scaled evaluations.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-20.title: Practice: Compute Real Answer Diversity Across Sampled Generations
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-20.description: Implement self-consistency rate calculation, a real reliability signal from sampling an agent's answer to the SAME question multiple times -- high agreement across samples correlates with genuine confidence.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-21.title: Practice: Detect Metric Drift Between Deploys
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-21.description: Implement deploy-over-deploy metric drift detection, a real automated check comparing a new deployment's key metric against the historical distribution from prior deploys.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-22.title: Practice: Build a Real-Time Dashboard Rollup Window
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-22.description: Implement time-bucket assignment for dashboard rollups, the real primitive behind aggregating a high-volume event stream into fixed-size time windows for display.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-23.title: Practice: Compute Real Precision and Recall for a Binary Judge
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-23.description: Implement precision and recall computation for a binary agent classification/judgment task, the standard real metrics distinguishing two different real error costs (false positives vs. false negatives).

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-24.title: Practice: Detect Flaky Test Cases Across Repeated Eval Runs
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-24.description: Implement flaky-test detection across repeated eval runs, catching test cases whose result genuinely isn't deterministic -- a real, important distinction from tests that reliably pass or reliably fail.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-25.title: Practice: Compute Real Token-Efficiency Score
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-25.description: Implement token-efficiency scoring, a real metric capturing that a SUCCESSFUL agent using fewer tokens than a baseline is genuinely more efficient, while a failed run should score zero regardless of token usage.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-26.title: Practice: Correlate Metric Anomaly With Deploy Event
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-26.description: Implement deploy-correlation checking, a real, first diagnostic step whenever an observability system flags an anomaly -- was this caused by a recent deploy, or something else entirely.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-27.title: Practice: Compute Real Judge-Model Bias Toward Position
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-27.description: Implement position-bias detection for an LLM-as-judge pairwise comparison setup, a real, well-documented failure mode where judges systematically favor whichever answer appears first/second regardless of actual quality.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-28.title: Practice: Compute Real Uptime SLA Percentage
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-28.description: Implement uptime percentage calculation, the real, direct arithmetic behind reporting an agent-serving system's SLA compliance (e.g. 'three nines' = 99.9%).

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-29.title: Practice: Aggregate Multi-Turn Conversation Success Rate
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-29.description: Implement conversation-level (not turn-level) success rate computation, the real metric that actually matters for a multi-turn agent -- a conversation with even one broken turn is usually a real failed user experience overall.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-3.title: Practice: Inter-Rater Agreement (Cohen's Kappa)
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-3.description: Implement Cohen's Kappa, the real, standard statistic for measuring agreement between two evaluators (human or LLM-judge) beyond what chance alone would predict.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-4.title: Practice: Structured Log Line Formatting
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-4.description: Implement structured JSON log-line formatting, the real, standard output format an observability pipeline (not humans) actually needs to parse agent logs reliably.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-5.title: Practice: Compute Eval Suite Pass Rate by Category
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-5.description: Implement per-category eval pass-rate breakdown, a real diagnostic step revealing WHICH kind of task an agent is actually weak on, rather than one opaque overall score.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-6.title: Practice: Token-Level F1 Score for Answer Matching
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-6.description: Implement token-level F1 score, the standard soft-matching metric (as used in SQuAD-style QA evaluation) for comparing a free-text agent answer against a reference answer.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-7.title: Practice: Detect Test-Set Contamination via Overlap
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-7.description: Implement a real, simple contamination check, flagging when eval benchmark examples appear to overlap with training data -- a genuine, common cause of inflated eval scores that don't reflect real generalization.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-8.title: Practice: Compute Distributed Trace Span Duration
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-8.description: Implement trace-span duration calculation, the basic real building block of any observability trace visualization for an agent's multi-step execution.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-9.title: Practice: Aggregate Trace Spans Into a Tree
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-9.description: Implement span-tree reconstruction, assembling flat trace spans (each with a parent reference) into the real hierarchical call tree an observability UI actually displays.

/docs/visual-lab/agent-execution-graph.title: Agent Execution Graph
/docs/visual-lab/agent-execution-graph.description: Step through a scripted, clickable ReAct loop trace -- see exactly how an agent's reasoning, tool calls, and observations unfold turn by turn.

/docs/visual-lab/algorithm-selector.title: Algorithm Selector
/docs/visual-lab/algorithm-selector.description: A real branching decision tool over this site's own ML pages -- answer a few questions, get pointed at the actual technique that fits your situation.

/docs/visual-lab/attention-step-through.title: Attention Step-Through
/docs/visual-lab/attention-step-through.description: A live QKV/softmax attention heatmap with per-token, multi-head breakdown -- type a sentence and watch real attention weights compute.

/docs/visual-lab/decision-boundary-playg.title: Decision Boundary Playground
/docs/visual-lab/decision-boundary-playg.description: Click to add points and watch KNN, decision tree, and k-means decision boundaries update live -- the fastest way to build intuition for how each one works.

/docs/visual-lab/embedding-space-explore.title: Embedding Space Explorer
/docs/visual-lab/embedding-space-explore.description: A real from-scratch PCA projection, cosine-similarity nearest neighbors, and word-vector analogy, computed live over a hand-built 48-word demo vocabulary.

/docs/visual-lab/gradient-descent-explor.title: Gradient Descent Explorer
/docs/visual-lab/gradient-descent-explor.description: Drive SGD, Momentum, and Adam yourself across a live, clickable loss surface -- the same elongated "ravine" shape from Optimizers, except you're driving.

/docs/visual-lab/graph-tree-traversal.title: Graph & Tree Traversal, Step by Step
/docs/visual-lab/graph-tree-traversal.description: An editable graph with real BFS vs. DFS stepped through live, plus a fixed-tree Lowest Common Ancestor finder with a real recursive call-by-call trace.

/docs/visual-lab/inference-flow-visualiz.title: LLM Inference Flow Visualizer
/docs/visual-lab/inference-flow-visualiz.description: A clickable tokenizer-to-sampling pipeline with a real, live sampling playground -- see temperature, top-k, and top-p actually change token selection.

/docs/visual-lab/lasso-regression-studio.title: Lasso Regression Studio
/docs/visual-lab/lasso-regression-studio.description: Real coordinate-descent soft-thresholding on the same dataset as Ridge Studio -- a directly comparable, live path showing exact feature elimination.

/docs/visual-lab/linear-regression-studi.title: Linear Regression Studio
/docs/visual-lab/linear-regression-studi.description: Drag-the-line fitting, an MSE/outlier experiment, and a real gradient descent lab with a live loss surface, all on one real dataset.

/docs/visual-lab/logistic-regression-stu.title: Logistic Regression Studio
/docs/visual-lab/logistic-regression-stu.description: Real sigmoid curve fitting plus a live cross-entropy vs. MSE-on-sigmoid convexity comparison -- see why the loss function choice actually matters.

/docs/visual-lab/neural-network-playgrou.title: Neural Network Playground
/docs/visual-lab/neural-network-playgrou.description: A configurable toy-dataset classifier, trained live in your browser -- pick the architecture and dataset, watch it actually learn in real time.

/docs/visual-lab/overview.title: Visual Lab — Overview
/docs/visual-lab/overview.description: Every visualization here is live -- set the parameters, click the canvas, and watch gradient descent or a neural network respond to your input in real time.

/docs/visual-lab/rag-pipeline-simulator.title: RAG Pipeline Simulator
/docs/visual-lab/rag-pipeline-simulator.description: Adjustable chunking, top-k, and reranking with live retrieved-chunk results -- see exactly how each RAG pipeline knob changes what gets retrieved.

/docs/visual-lab/ridge-regression-studio.title: Ridge Regression Studio
/docs/visual-lab/ridge-regression-studio.description: A real closed-form ridge regression solve on a multicollinear dataset, with a live regularization path as you adjust the penalty strength.

/docs/visual-lab/roadmap.title: Visual Lab — Roadmap
/docs/visual-lab/roadmap.description: Every shipped interactive tool in one list: gradient descent, attention, RAG, regression studios, decision boundaries, and DSA algorithm walkthroughs, all live.

/docs/visual-lab/two-pointers-sliding-wi.title: Two Pointers & Sliding Window, Step by Step
/docs/visual-lab/two-pointers-sliding-wi.description: An editable array or string with real two-pointer and sliding-window algorithms stepped through one move at a time -- the first DSA piece in Visual Lab.
